title: Constant Getaway
meta_description: Constant Getaway offers bright coastal living near 30A beaches, dining, and bike paths, with bikes, a golf cart, and outdoor lounge space.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Constant Getaway by AvantStay, a bright and breezy two-story retreat tucked into one of Santa Rosa Beach's most beloved coastal corridors. Here, you're perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of 30A---just minutes from sugar-white shores, the family-friendly energy of Gulf Place, vibrant local dining, scenic bike paths, and the laid-back Gulf Coast atmosphere that makes this region so unforgettable. Two complimentary bikes and a 6-seater golf cart make beach runs, sunset rides, and local exploring effortless and fun.

This light-blue coastal home opens into a sunlit, open-concept living space where clean white interiors, soft neutrals, and thoughtfully curated décor set the tone for effortless relaxation. Settle in for movie nights on the comfortable sofas, prep beach-day snacks in the fully equipped kitchen, or gather around the spacious island while dinner sizzles on the stove.

Step outside to discover one of the home's standout features: a covered outdoor lounge with a large TV, dining table for six, a second table with seating for four, and a gas grill---perfect for evening cookouts and lingering conversations after a day on the sand. At the front of the home, two Adirondack chairs offer a quiet moment in the sun with your morning coffee.

Across four well-appointed bedrooms and an additional hallway bunk nook, the home comfortably accommodates groups of up to 10. Two king suites---each with a private ensuite featuring a double vanity and walk-in shower---provide spa-like retreats for primary guests. A queen room and a dedicated bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks offer flexible sleeping options for families or friends, while the cozy bunk nook adds extra space for younger travelers. A shared full bath with a double vanity and tub/shower combo, plus a convenient half bath, make the layout easy for larger groups.

Additional amenities include a washer and dryer, high-speed WiFi, and all the essentials needed for a seamless, memorable stay along Florida's scenic Emerald Coast.

Whether you're planning beach days, cruising the neighborhood by golf cart, or enjoying slow mornings surrounded by calm coastal light, Constant Getaway is your home base for the perfect 30A experience.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- This home allows 1 pet, up to 35 lbs, for a $250 pet fee. If undisclosed or unapproved pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, a $500 fine per pet will be charged.
- Please note your home comes equipped with a pack'n'play.
- Please place trash cans on the side of the house after pickup. To comply with community rules, visible trash cans may result in fines for the owner.
- A 6-seater golf cart is provided complimentary; guests must sign a waiver to use it.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 2 vehicles.
- Additional parking is available in the community parking areas at the front of the neighborhood or by the community pool.
- Street parking is not allowed. The HOA will tow vehicles parked on the street.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
